# stalwart_data_retention (Data Source)

Configures data retention policies, expunge schedules, and archival settings. This singleton object always exists: creating the resource adopts the current server settings and destroying it only removes the resource from state.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `archive_deleted_accounts_for` (Number) How long to keep deleted accounts in the archive before they are permanently deleted. If null, deleted accounts will be permanently deleted immediately. Requires an Enterprise license.
- `archive_deleted_items_for` (Number) How long to keep deleted items in the archive before they are permanently deleted. If null, deleted items will not be archived and will be permanently deleted immediately. Requires an Enterprise license.
- `blob_cleanup_schedule` (Attributes) How often to purge the data store. Expects a cron expression. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--blob_cleanup_schedule))
- `data_cleanup_schedule` (Attributes) How often to purge the data store. Expects a cron expression. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--data_cleanup_schedule))
- `expunge_schedule` (Attributes) Specifies when to run the auto-expunge process (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--expunge_schedule))
- `expunge_scheduling_inbox_after` (Number) Sets the duration after which the iTIP inbox will automatically expunge old messages.
- `expunge_share_notify_after` (Number) Specifies the duration for which the JMAP share notification history is retained before it is automatically purged.
- `expunge_submissions_after` (Number) How long to keep sent e-mail submissions before auto-expunging
- `expunge_trash_after` (Number) How long to keep messages in the Trash and Junk Mail folders before auto-expunging
- `hold_metrics_for` (Number) How long to keep metrics history before it is permanently deleted. Requires an Enterprise license.
- `hold_mta_reports_for` (Number) The duration for which MTA reports should be stored before being deleted, or None to disable storage
- `hold_traces_for` (Number) How long to keep message delivery history before it is permanently deleted. Requires an Enterprise license.
- `id` (String) Always `singleton`.
- `max_changes_history` (Number) How many changes to keep in the history for each account. This is used to determine the changes that have occurred since the last time the client requested changes.
- `metrics_collection_interval` (Attributes) Specifies how often to collect metrics history. Requires an Enterprise license. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--metrics_collection_interval))
